description_en: Queries the list of malicious sample files in container images
description_zh: 查询镜像恶意样本文件列表
name: DescribeGroupedMaliciousFiles

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The severity levels of the malicious samples in container images that you want to query. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
serious: urgent
suspicious: suspicious
remind: reminder
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的镜像恶意样本的危险程度。可输入多个值，多个值之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒
parameters.name: levels

parameters.help_en:
The name of the malicious file that you want to query.
Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的恶意文件名称。
支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: fuzzy_malicious_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据的最大条数。默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the image repository. Valid values:
cn-beijing: China (Beijing)
cn-zhangjiakou: China (Zhangjiakou)
cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou)
cn-shanghai: China (Shanghai)
cn-shenzhen: China (Shenzhen)
cn-hongkong: Hong Kong (China)
ap-southeast-1: Singapore
ap-southeast-5: Indonesia (Jakarta)
us-east-1: US (Virginia)
us-west-1: US (Silicon Valley)
eu-central-1: Germany (Frankfurt)
eu-west-1: UK (London)
parameters.help_zh:
镜像仓库的地域ID。取值：
cn-beijing：华北2（北京）
cn-zhangjiakou：华北3（张家口）
cn-hangzhou：华东1（杭州）
cn-shanghai：华东2（上海）
cn-shenzhen：华南1（深圳）
cn-hongkong：中国香港
ap-southeast-1：新加坡
ap-southeast-5：印度尼西亚（雅加达）
us-east-1：美国（弗吉尼亚）
us-west-1：美国（硅谷）
eu-central-1：德国（法兰克福）
eu-west-1：英国（伦敦）
parameters.name: repo_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the container image.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145293.html operation of Container Registry to obtain the value of the InstanceId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
容器镜像的实例ID。
调用容器镜像服务的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145293.html接口，通过返回参数**InstanceId**的值可以获取容器镜像实ID
parameters.name: repo_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the image repository.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145293.html operation of Container Registry to obtain the value of the RepoId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
镜像仓库ID。
调用容器镜像服务的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145293.html接口，通过返回参数**RepoId**的值可以获取镜像仓库ID
parameters.name: repo_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image repository.
Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
镜像仓库名称。
支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: repo_name

parameters.help_en:
The namespace of the image repository.
Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
镜像仓库命名空间名称。
支持模糊查询
parameters.name: repo_namespace

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID of the server for which you want to query exception events
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询异常事件的服务器的集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The MD5 hash of the malicious file
parameters.name: malicious_md5

GroupedMaliciousFileResponse.description_en: The list of malicious sample files

items.description_en: The information about the malicious sample file in the container image
items.description_zh: 镜像恶意样本文件信息

FirstScanTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the first scan. Unit: milliseconds
FirstScanTimestamp.description_zh: 首次扫描时间戳，单位：毫秒

ImageCount.description_en: The number of images affected by the malicious sample
ImageCount.description_zh: 被恶意样本影响的镜像数量

LatestScanTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the latest scan. Unit: milliseconds
LatestScanTimestamp.description_zh: 最新扫描时间戳，单位：毫秒

Level.description_en:
The severity level of the malicious sample in the container image. Valid values:
serious: urgent
suspicious: suspicious
remind: reminder
Level.description_zh:
镜像恶意样本的危险程度。取值：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒

MaliciousKey.description_en: The keyword of the malicious file

MaliciousMd5.description_en: The MD5 hash of the malicious file

MaliciousName.description_en: The name of the malicious file

Status.description_en:
The handling status of the malicious sample in the container image. Valid values:
0: Unhandled.
1: Handled.
2: Verifying.
3: Whitelisted
Status.description_zh:
镜像恶意样本的处理状态。取值：
0：未处理
1：已处理
2：验证中
3：已加白

Count.description_en: The number of malicious sample files returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页返回的恶意样本文件的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据的最大条数。默认值为20

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of malicious sample files

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
